short: The ZurfurApi port, errors, generated messages
is: The backend boundary: one `ZurfurApi` service (a live HTTP Layer, a mock in-memory Layer for `yarn dev`, and an in-memory test Layer), a tagged error union, the Den read's port shape, and the protobuf-es messages generated from `contract/`.
conventions: Decode only through `decodeContract` / the generated schemas — hand-rolled `fromJson` and hand-written narrowing are banned.
Generated types stop at this directory.
Failures are values in the tagged union; the RFC 9457 Problem rides inside the tags that carry one.
`zurfur-api-mock.ts` implements the FULL `ZurfurApiShape`, not a `Partial` — it fails to compile when the shape grows, so mock mode can't silently drift from the real port.
entry_points: zurfur-api.ts (the port and its live Layer)

fs.name: *.spec.ts
fs.role: port specs (zurfur-api-limits.spec.ts: each call's own time limit on fake timers, the body bounded too, no timer left behind, an interrupted call aborted; the live Den reads' paths, failures and route-template-only errors among them) + den-wire.spec.ts (the tolerant reader's every Den fallback, a name's number among them, through the live port and the den program) + name-ordinals.spec.ts (the mock's numbering against the shared case file contract/golden/name-ordinals.json) + two infrastructure pins (tolerant-reader decode option; undici redirect:'manual' against a live local server) + the mock Layer's own spec (mock mode only in a dev build, the live API otherwise; the boot guard's misconfiguration cases)

fs.name: den-mock.ts
fs.role: the mock Den world: alice's Den per the approved fixture tree (accounts from the mock store, Ember, Kael-sona, "Untitled", posts) and the commissions the mock created, from the store, plus HAND-MADE extras (a card, an archived commission, a deactivated Account, a paged folder, a very long and a right-to-left name); every crumb typed, commission and Account nodes naming their thing; equal names numbered by name-ordinals.ts over the viewer's whole filtered listing (open entries before cards, then key), listed in that same order (by name, then open entries before cards, then key); the node and each crumb numbered as their parent's listing numbers them; isOpenFixtureCommission tells the mock which fixed commissions it shows open; 25-entry pages, `p1.<offset>` tokens

fs.name: den-read.ts
fs.role: the Den reads' port shape (DenQuery, DenRead, DenReadNode, DenReadThing…): the Den contract as plain data with raw vocabularies; the mock and the live decode both produce it (an open node's optional thing, a crumb's type, a node's and a crumb's minted name ordinal beside its bare name)

fs.name: den-wire.ts
fs.role: the live Den decode: generated Den answers mapped to DenRead, failing closed (anything but open access is a card, unknown or absent content is none, empty soft-delete and page token are absent, an answer with no node is undefined, an unknown or empty thing, or a blank Account DID, is no thing, a crumb without a type reads empty, a name ordinal that isn't a whole number of 2 or more is none); DEN_ROUTES, the route templates Den failures name

fs.name: errors.ts
fs.role: the tagged failure union (NotAuthenticated, ApiProblem, ContractViolation, NetworkFailure, SignoutFailed); NetworkFailure carries only its reason (unreachable, timeout, aborted), never the fetch's rejection

fs.name: generated/
fs.role: protobuf-es output from contract/ — messages only, no clients; prettier-ignored

fs.name: name-ordinals.ts
fs.role: the mock's copy of the rule that tells equal names in one Den folder apart: nameOrdinals (groups by comparisonKey, the exact name for now — the one function an NFC switch changes; each later member of a group gets the smallest free "name (n)" from 2, rising)

fs.name: zurfur-api-mock.ts
fs.role: the mock ZurfurApi Layer — full in-memory stand-in for ZurfurApiLive so `yarn dev` renders a signed-in app with no backend; the one place mock-mode-enabled is read; createCommission refuses a blank title (name_empty) and one holding a bidirectional control (name_invisible) at #/title with the backend's details, and stores the rest under a fresh time-ordered (UUIDv7-shaped) id that is also its segment, so a later twin sorts after an earlier one; renameCommission renames a commission it created with the same title refusals, answers a fixed commission the Den shows open 403 forbidden (as the backend answers a Participant who isn't the owner), and any other id the commission not-found; fileBugReport keeps nothing and answers a made-up reference

fs.name: zurfur-api.ts
fs.role: the port: every backend call as one service, each through backendFetch, which bounds the whole call (body read included) by its time limit (time-limits.ts), settling by its own timer even if the abort never reaches the fetch (bounded-fetch.ts), and stops the fetch when the call is interrupted; a call that runs out fails NetworkFailure timeout (Den reads denRoot/denNode call GET /den and /den/{path}, decode through den-wire.ts, and name only the route template in any failure; a path the builder refuses is the one not-found with no fetch), decodeContract (tolerant reader); problems decode their field errors tolerantly (a mistyped `errors` member is ignored, the problem kept), RequestFetch, ZurfurApiLive + zurfurApiTest; account delete builds its path through path-builder.ts; createCommission POSTs /commissions, its id minted through commissionId (an answer whose id doesn't mint is a ContractViolation); renameCommission PATCHes /commissions/{id}/title, its path built through path-builder.ts (a refused id is the commission not-found with no fetch), every failure naming only the route template; fileBugReport posts a BugReportFiling to /bug-reports through the generated schema, an item not sent left off the wire, and decodes the reference (a malformed one is a ContractViolation)

notes: zurfur-api-mock.ts — why one shared flag reader: `mockModeRequested`/`mockModeEnabled`/`mockModeMisconfigured` are read in exactly this one module so `runtime.ts`'s seam branch, the `/mock/signin` route's fail-closed 404, and `hooks.server.ts`'s boot-time prod guard all agree on the same flag the same way — no second call site can drift from it. State lives in one shared `MockStore` (`sharedStore`) seeded signed-in with a fixture visitor and one owner membership; the dev process runs on a single module-scope instance so a request's Layer and the `/mock/signin` route see the same world, and it resets harmlessly on server restart or HMR (never load-bearing for anything real). A test builds its own store with `createMockStore` instead of touching the shared one. Loopback assumption: mock mode is safe only because `vite dev` binds `127.0.0.1` by default — `just dev-mock` must never be paired with `--host`.
See also: `contract/zurfur/api/v1/` (the source the `generated/` tree comes from).
See also: memory `feedback_make_unsoundness_unreachable` (one shared enforced path, cited by `zurfur-api-mock.ts`).
